staffBriefing.title: Staff Briefing Centre
staffBriefing.subtitle: Assign staff as optional advisors for additional analysis and reports.
staffBriefing.infoTitle: What do I get with an advisor?
staffBriefing.infoIntro: Hiring staff and buying Staff Advisory are separate. Your employees continue their normal jobs without Staff Advisory. The 5-coin option adds proactive analysis and role-specific reports for 30 real-life days.
staffBriefing.withoutText: You still receive all normal gameplay notifications and essential warnings: race and stage-plan deadlines, injuries and sickness, rider/staff contract expiry, race-supply shortages, sponsor and finance warnings, scouting-task completion, transfers, and other normal game events. Hired staff also continue performing their normal gameplay jobs.
staffBriefing.withTitle: With Staff Advisory — 5 coins / 30 real-life days
staffBriefing.withText: The selected employee becomes your advisor for that role. Advisor access adds proactive analytical reports and advisor-only notifications. These reports interpret information you already have; they do not reveal hidden attributes, change race calculations, improve rider stats, or replace Free warnings.
staffBriefing.neverLocksText: Essential warnings and normal game results remain available without Staff Advisory. Advisory is additional interpretation and planning support only.
staffBriefing.noEligible: No eligible staff members are available for this role.
staffBriefing.notEnoughCoins: Not enough coins. {{required}} coins are required and your current balance is {{balance}}.
staffBriefing.couldNotLoad: Staff Advisory details are temporarily unavailable.
staffBriefing.eligibleOne: 1 eligible staff member is available for advisory support.
staffBriefing.eligibleMany: {{count}} eligible staff members are available for advisory support.
staffBriefing.hireRole: Hire an eligible {{role}} on the Staff page before assigning an advisor.

roleInfo.headCoach: Weekly training and readiness review: workload trends, repeated fatigue, morale/readiness patterns, development trends, and riders who may need closer management.
roleInfo.sportsDirector: Weekly race-program review: calendar congestion, rider-selection load, preparation risks, overlapping commitments, and areas of the race programme worth reviewing.
roleInfo.teamDoctor: Health and recovery analysis, at most once per real-life day: squad availability, repeated injury/sickness patterns, recovery trends, and health situations worth monitoring.
roleInfo.chiefMechanic: Weekly equipment review: condition and maintenance trends, recurring equipment issues, workload on the workshop, and race-supply usage worth reviewing.
roleInfo.scout: Weekly recruitment review using already-known scouting information: completed report summary, recruitment gaps, known prospects worth revisiting, and suggestions for where to scout next.

staffBriefing.pausedVacant: This role is vacant. Your paid advisory time is preserved and is not counting down.
staffBriefing.resumedForReplacement: Unused paid advisory time resumed automatically for this replacement.
staffBriefing.pausedRenewIntro: Your existing paid time is preserved. This optional renewal adds {{days}} real-life days for {{coins}} coins. Hiring a replacement does not require another purchase.
staffBriefing.pausedRenewIntroGeneric: Your existing paid time is preserved while this role is vacant. Hiring a replacement resumes it automatically and does not cost coins. Extending the entitlement is an optional paid action.
staffBriefing.couldNotLoadRenewalQuote: Could not load the advisory renewal quote.
staffBriefing.couldNotRenewPaused: Could not renew the paused Staff Advisory entitlement.
